name: Claude Code Plugin & Multi-Plugin Structure
description:
Add harness-specific plugin bundles to Agent Plan so it integrates natively with multiple coding-agent harnesses, starting with Claude Code and followed by Codex.

## Current state
- Monorepo (pnpm) under `packages/`: plan-core, plan-mcp, plan-server, plan-web-ui, agent-plan (CLI), pi-adapter (Pi extension).
- @agent-plan/mcp exposes planner-* tools via stdio MCP; already used by Claude Code via manual `agent-plan setup claude-code` command-file install.
- pi-adapter implements session_start notify, /planner load/stop, web lifecycle, recap with URL (Pi-only via message_end hook).
- No plugin/ directory exists yet. The Claude Code integration currently relies on a manually-installed command file (~/.claude/commands/planner.md) + standalone MCP config.

## Goal
- Top-level `plugins/` dir with one subdirectory per harness (claude-code/, codex/, _shared/).
- A self-hosted Claude Code plugin bundling: .mcp.json (@agent-plan/mcp), skills/planner/SKILL.md (/planner routing), hooks/hooks.json (SessionStart non-blocking notify), marketplace.json.
- Distribution via self-hosted marketplace (channel 2, no Anthropic approval): `/plugin marketplace add ovidius72/agent-planner` → `/plugin install agent-plan@agent-plan-marketplace`.
- Reusable _shared/ templates so Codex (and future harnesses) reuse the /planner routing and SessionStart notify.

## Behaviors to preserve
- Planner disabled by default; web does NOT auto-start (user constraint: "non parte in automatico").
- /planner load = enable + web(LAN) + recap with Web UI address; /planner stop = disable + stop web.
- Web UI address only on /planner load recap or /planner web status (not appended to every message — Claude Code has no message_end equivalent).
- Planner operations (handoff, CRUD) are NOT code edits; allowed regardless of task state.
- Composite IDs F00x/P00x/T00x in chat, never raw UUIDs.

## Code references
- packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts — planner-* MCP tools, planner-web stub→implemented (PR #11 merged), planner-load/stop (PR #16 in flight on fix/mcp-parity-recap-web-ui).
- packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts:plannerCommandTemplate — current Claude Code command-file template (source to port into SKILL.md).
- packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts — reference for session_start notify, /planner load/stop, web lifecycle, recap behavior.
- .github/workflows/publish.yml — npm publish on main; plugins are NOT npm packages so not covered by it.

## Non-goals
- Submitting to the official claude-plugins-official directory (optional future, not this feature).
- Building the Codex plugin (placeholder only; separate feature later).
- Changing @agent-plan/mcp tool semantics (already aligned in PR #11/#16).

acceptedDecisions.title: Plugins separated from packages
acceptedDecisions.decision: Plugin bundles live in a top-level plugins/ directory, separate from packages/ (which holds publishable npm libraries).
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Plugins are static bundles (JSON+Markdown+shell), not npm packages; keeping them out of the pnpm workspace avoids polluting the publishable set and cleanly separates 'libraries' from 'harness bundles'.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: plugins/ at repo root; packages/ unchanged. Each plugin is self-contained and distributable via its harness mechanism.

acceptedDecisions.title: One subdirectory per harness + _shared/ templates
acceptedDecisions.decision: plugins/ has one subdirectory per harness (claude-code/, codex/) plus _shared/ holding single-source-of-truth templates.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Supports multiple harnesses without duplication; _shared/ ensures the /planner routing and SessionStart notify stay consistent across harnesses.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: plugins/_shared/planner-skill.md.in and notify-session-start.sh.in use {{HARNESS}}/{{LOAD_COMMAND}} placeholders substituted by a sync script.

acceptedDecisions.title: Planner logic stays in @agent-plan/mcp
acceptedDecisions.decision: The planner tools remain in the @agent-plan/mcp npm package; plugins reference it via .mcp.json using `npx -y @agent-plan/mcp`.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Single implementation of planner-* tools reused by every harness plugin; no logic duplication across plugins; consistent with the harness-agnostic core principle (AGENTS.md §3).
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: plugins/claude-code/.mcp.json declares the stdio MCP server; auto-starts when the plugin is enabled.

acceptedDecisions.title: Planner disabled by default; web does not auto-start
acceptedDecisions.decision: The planner and its web dashboard are disabled by default at startup. Nothing starts automatically.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Explicit user constraint: 'il planner non deve partire automaticamente ma solo se l'utente chiama load'. Avoids unwanted server processes and respects user control.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: SessionStart hook is notification-only; the planner is enabled only via /planner load.

acceptedDecisions.title: /planner load and /planner stop semantics
acceptedDecisions.decision: /planner load enables the planner, starts the web dashboard LAN-bound, and emits a recap (status + handoff + Web UI address). /planner stop (alias disable) disables the planner and stops the web dashboard.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Mirrors the Pi adapter behavior (PR #16) for cross-harness parity; gives the user a single explicit on/off switch.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Routes to planner-load and planner-stop MCP tools (post-PR #16). Web binds to 0.0.0.0 with a dynamic OS-assigned port.

acceptedDecisions.title: Web UI address only on load recap or web status
acceptedDecisions.decision: The Web UI address is shown only in the /planner load recap and via /planner web status. It is NOT appended to every assistant message.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Claude Code has no message_end hook equivalent to modify the final assistant message (unlike Pi). This matches the user's accepted behavior (URL only on load/status) and avoids noisy repetition on every turn.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Recap URL comes from the planner-load tool response; /planner web status from planner-web status action.

acceptedDecisions.title: SessionStart hook is non-blocking notification only
acceptedDecisions.decision: The SessionStart hook prints a non-blocking notification ('Planner available — run /planner load') and does NOT start the planner, the web, or inject a recap.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Parity with the Pi session_start notify; respects the no-auto-start constraint; gives discoverability without forcing startup.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: hooks/hooks.json SessionStart → command running scripts/notify-session-start.sh; exit 0 always.

acceptedDecisions.title: Self-hosted marketplace distribution (no approval)
acceptedDecisions.decision: Distribute via a self-hosted marketplace (channel 2): marketplace.json in the repo, users add via /plugin marketplace add ovidius72/agent-planner. The official directory (channel 3) is an optional future step.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Channel 2 requires no Anthropic approval and is immediate; channel 3 requires public repo + automated review and only adds reach, not functionality.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: plugins/claude-code/marketplace.json lists the agent-plan plugin. Future channel-3 submission uses the same artifacts.

acceptedDecisions.title: Planner operations are not code edits
acceptedDecisions.decision: Planner operations (plan_write_handoff, plan_get, feature/phase/task CRUD) are NOT code edits and are always allowed regardless of task state.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: Prevents the guard from blocking handoff writing or planning when no task is in-progress (user-reported blocker). Aligns with AGENTS.md operational protocol.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Documented in SKILL.md operational protocol; the PostToolUse guard (if added later) skips .planner/ paths.

acceptedDecisions.title: Composite IDs in chat, never raw UUIDs
acceptedDecisions.decision: Entity references in chat use human composite IDs (F001, P001(F001), T001(P001/F001)); tools emit composite IDs; findTaskByRef/findPhaseByRef/findFeatureByRef accept composite IDs and short forms.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: AGENTS.md §9 communication rule; eliminates agents referencing UUIDs invisible in the Web UI (user-reported issue).
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Routing in SKILL.md instructs composite IDs; relies on the core composite-ID tooling (post global-uniqueness decision).
